<?php

use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Modules\AI\Tests\Support\Situation;
use OGame\Models\Planet;
use OGame\Services\ObjectService;
use Tests\IsolatedAccountTestCase;

require_once __DIR__ . '/../../Support/Situation.php';

uses(IsolatedAccountTestCase::class);

// QUAL-003 (invariant:NAKED_BESIDE_WALLED, aspect:shipyard): the live cohort's planets are poor, not the
// fifty-million test planet. A live account read "1 planet at zero defence while one holds 1,566 units":
// the walled planet is walled, and the sibling beside it stays at zero for a whole day because what it
// earns is spent each login and never reaches the price of the wall unit it owes.
test('a day of a walled homeworld leaves its poor colony holding a wall', function (): void {
    $before = Planet::query()->where('user_id', $this->currentUserId)->pluck('id')->all();

    $situation = Situation::of($this)
        ->level('robot_factory', 2)
        ->level('shipyard', 4)
        ->defence('rocket_launcher', 20)
        ->colony()
        ->stockEveryPlanet(6_000, 3_000, 1_000);

    $situation->day();

    foreach (Planet::query()->where('user_id', $this->currentUserId)->where('planet_type', 1)->pluck('id') as $planetId) {
        $row = (array) DB::table('planets')->where('id', (int) $planetId)->first();
        $built = 0;
        foreach (ObjectService::getDefenseObjects() as $defence) {
            $built += (int) ($row[$defence->machine_name] ?? 0);
        }

        expect($built)->toBeGreaterThan(0, 'planet ' . $planetId . ' holds no built defence after a day; ' . $situation->account());
    }
});

// The bound at zero: the colony is left exactly as the host settles one -- no stock of its own and every
// mine still at nothing -- and the account has to reach it out of what that colony earns while it plays.
// A bare sibling spends every login's trickle on the next cheap mine, so what it earns never reaches the
// wall unit it owes and the planet stays at zero beside its sibling's wall however long the account plays.
test('a day of a walled homeworld leaves its empty colony holding a wall', function (): void {
    $situation = Situation::of($this)
        ->level('robot_factory', 2)
        ->level('shipyard', 4)
        ->defence('rocket_launcher', 20)
        ->colony();

    $colonyId = (int) Planet::query()->where('user_id', $this->currentUserId)->where('planet_type', 1)
        ->whereKeyNot($this->currentPlanetId)->value('id');
    $steps = array_map(static fn ($step): string => class_basename($step) . '@' . $step->planetId . ':' . $step->reason, app(\Modules\AI\Domain\Decision\QueueableBuildingPlanner::class)->steps($this->currentUserId));
    $walls = array_map(static fn ($order): string => $order->planetId . ':' . $order->unitId . ':' . $order->amount . ':' . $order->reason, app(\Modules\AI\Domain\Decision\QueueableUnitPlanner::class)->standingDefenceOrders($this->currentUserId));

    $planner = app(\Modules\AI\Domain\Decision\QueueableBuildingPlanner::class);
    $chain = app(\Modules\AI\Domain\Decision\FacilityChain::class);
    $report = [];
    foreach (Planet::query()->where('user_id', $this->currentUserId)->where('planet_type', 1)->pluck('id') as $planetId) {
        $planet = app(\OGame\Factories\PlanetServiceFactory::class)->make((int) $planetId, true);
        $planet->updateResources(false);
        $candidates = [];
        foreach ($chain->wallPending($planet) as $candidate) {
            $object = ObjectService::getObjectById($candidate->buildingId);
            $candidates[] = $object->machine_name . '(' . $candidate->reason . ':' . ($planner->refusal($planet, $candidate) ?? 'ok') . ')';
        }
        $report[] = 'planet ' . $planetId
            . ' rf=' . $planet->getObjectLevel('robot_factory') . ' sy=' . $planet->getObjectLevel('shipyard')
            . ' mm=' . $planet->getObjectLevel('metal_mine') . ' sp=' . $planet->getObjectLevel('solar_plant')
            . ' ds=' . $planet->getObjectLevel('deuterium_synthesizer')
            . ' metal=' . $planet->metal()->get() . ' crystal=' . $planet->crystal()->get() . ' deut=' . $planet->deuterium()->get()
            . ' prod=' . round($planet->getMetalProductionPerHour(), 1) . '/' . round($planet->getCrystalProductionPerHour(), 1) . '/' . round($planet->getDeuteriumProductionPerHour(), 1)
            . ' wallPending=[' . implode(', ', $candidates) . ']';
    }

    expect(implode(' || ', $report) . ' || steps: ' . implode(', ', $steps) . ' || walls: ' . implode(', ', $walls))->toBeString();

    $situation->day();

    $after = [];
    foreach (Planet::query()->where('user_id', $this->currentUserId)->where('planet_type', 1)->pluck('id') as $planetId) {
        $planet = app(\OGame\Factories\PlanetServiceFactory::class)->make((int) $planetId, true);
        $defence = 0;
        foreach (ObjectService::getDefenseObjects() as $object) {
            $defence += $planet->getDefenseUnits()->getAmountByMachineName($object->machine_name);
        }
        $after[] = 'planet ' . $planetId
            . ' rf=' . $planet->getObjectLevel('robot_factory') . ' sy=' . $planet->getObjectLevel('shipyard')
            . ' mm=' . $planet->getObjectLevel('metal_mine') . ' sp=' . $planet->getObjectLevel('solar_plant')
            . ' ds=' . $planet->getObjectLevel('deuterium_synthesizer')
            . ' energy=' . round($planet->energy()->get(), 1)
            . ' prod=' . round($planet->getMetalProductionPerHour(), 1) . '/' . round($planet->getCrystalProductionPerHour(), 1) . '/' . round($planet->getDeuteriumProductionPerHour(), 1)
            . ' built=' . $defence;
    }

    expect(implode(' || ', $after))->toBe('');

    foreach (Planet::query()->where('user_id', $this->currentUserId)->where('planet_type', 1)->pluck('id') as $planetId) {
        $row = (array) DB::table('planets')->where('id', (int) $planetId)->first();
        $built = 0;
        foreach (ObjectService::getDefenseObjects() as $defence) {
            $built += (int) ($row[$defence->machine_name] ?? 0);
        }

        expect($built)->toBeGreaterThan(0, 'planet ' . $planetId . ' holds no built defence after a day; ' . $situation->account());
    }
});
